_comment: Provenance for the vendored THOX facts card. The card is OWNED by ttracx/thox-system-prompts at facts/thox_facts.json — edit it there, then re-run `python scripts/sync_facts.py`. Never edit facts/data/thox_facts.json in this repo.
_ref_note: Tracks ttracx/thox-system-prompts main (PR #1 merged 2026-07-24 as commit 388f2d8). `ref` is the branch scripts/sync_facts.py pulls and --check-upstream compares against; `commit` records the exact commit last synced. CI uses the offline `--check` (vendored sha256 == this file's sha256), so it does not depend on reaching upstream.
